# Additional evaluation cases (generated by `python3 code/evaluation/custom_cases.py`)

Hand-built worlds in evidence formats that no sample answer exercises. The expected answers were derived from the task contract before the pipeline was run; the scorer is the same one used for the samples.

## The cases

### case_901: Reporting-replica layout. The account row exists only in the replica (drift), the search document is in both tables, a decoy search document belongs to another person, the audit record must be kept.

Expected INCOMPLETE with 7 steps; produced INCOMPLETE with 7 steps; identical.

| # | phase | operation | system | resource | state | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FINDING | REPORT_REMAINING_RECORD | account_service | account_5001 | PRESENT | evidence_01 |
| 2 | FINDING | REPORT_REMAINING_RECORD | search_service | search_5002 | PRESENT | evidence_01 |
| 3 | REMEDIATION | DELETE_RECORD | account_service | account_5001 | ABSENT | - |
| 4 | REMEDIATION | DELETE_RECORD | search_service | search_5002 | ABSENT | - |
| 5 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT | account_service | account_5001 | ABSENT | - |
| 6 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT | search_service | search_5002 | ABSENT | - |
| 7 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_PRESENT | security_service | audit_record_5003 | PRESENT | - |

### case_902: Regional-replicas layout. The ghost account sits in one of two regional replicas only; the support attachment is in all three tables and is the person's own attachment (deleted, not redacted).

| 7 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_PRESENT | security_service | audit_record_5103 | PRESENT | - |

### case_903: Failover layout. The primary tombstone is redacted but the failover replica still holds the name and email: the tombstone is kept (never deleted) and redacted. The account has no row anywhere, only a successful delete event shortly before the report, so it is verified absent without a citation.

Expected INCOMPLETE with 5 steps; produced INCOMPLETE with 5 steps; identical.

| # | phase | operation | system | resource | state | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FINDING | REPORT_EXPOSED_PII | identity_service | tombstone_5201 | PRESENT | evidence_03 |
| 2 | REMEDIATION | REDACT_RECORD | identity_service | tombstone_5201 | REDACTED | - |
| 3 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT | account_service | account_5200 | ABSENT | - |
| 4 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_PRESENT | security_service | audit_record_5202 | PRESENT | - |
| 5 | VERIFICATION | VERIFY_RECORD_REDACTED | identity_service | tombstone_5201 | REDACTED | - |
